SYNTHETIC — fictional evaluation material.
[10/10/26, 9:14 PM] Example Border Desk (fictional): Thailand data entry job, salary Rs 1.2 lakh per month. Travel on a tourist visa; work permit after arrival.
[10/10/26, 9:15 PM] Example Border Desk (fictional): Pay Rs 2,50,000 by UPI today only. No receipt or contract. Hand your passport to our coordinator for the whole assignment.
[10/10/26, 9:16 PM] Applicant A (fictional): Where is your office and licence?
[10/10/26, 9:17 PM] Example Border Desk (fictional): WhatsApp only, +91 90000 00001; no office visits or licence number to share.
